resources.string: "No Mac found. Check that both devices share a Wi-Fi network and DualScreen is running on your Mac."
"Mac + tablet. More room for your ideas."
"More room to work — over USB or Wi-Fi."
"A stable connection\nNo shared Wi-Fi network needed"
"Requires a USB tunnel from the Mac app. A cable alone is not enough without ADB setup."
"Mac and tablet on the same network.\nYou choose the device."
"HEVC / H.264 · Touch controls · Up to 120 fps by default"
"If the connection drops, we will reconnect automatically."
"Your Mac rejected the connection. Check the Mac app."
"Android did not allow a background connection. Keep DualScreen open."
"Notifications are off, so you cannot return from the notification shade. Open DualScreen from recent apps. The connection is still running."
"A notification appears while connected to your Mac."
"Allow a silent notification to see connection status and frame rate. Tap it to return to DualScreen without reconnecting. Without permission, the connection still works; return using recent apps."

"1. Start DualScreen on your Mac.

2. Connect the devices with a data-capable cable. Enable developer options and USB debugging on your tablet. Authorize this Mac for debugging.

3. The Mac USB connection must create an ADB tunnel: adb reverse tcp:7381 tcp:7381. Without it, 127.0.0.1 does not reach your Mac.

4. Tap “Connect over USB”. If it does not connect, check the cable, debugging authorization and tunnel on your Mac."
"Enter a Mac address and a port from 1–65535. For a cable connection, use USB."
"Looking for Macs on your network… Choose a device from the list."
"Discovery is unavailable. Enter your Mac address manually."
"Search stopped. Choose a Mac or enter an address."

"A physical keyboard and mouse control your Mac over the video. Meta → Cmd, Alt → Option, Ctrl → Ctrl. Android may keep system keys and gestures on the tablet. The Android pointer is not captured. Logs contain no keystrokes or typed text."
"Mode and resolution are available after connecting."
"Extend, 30 fps — save tablet and Mac battery"
"Choose the source on your Mac. This switch only disables playback on the tablet."
"Decoder latency measures frame submission to decoder output, not Mac → tablet latency. Adaptive bitrate feedback is always active."
"Draws a pointer under your finger immediately while the Mac video catches up. Does not affect input."
"Text syncs with your Mac in both directions while connected. Logs never contain clipboard text: only its size and hash."
"The tablet microphone is sent to your Mac as an input device while connected. Only this switch enables recording. Audio is never logged."
"Search paused. Tap “Find a Mac over Wi-Fi”."
"Could not start the %1$s decoder. Try another codec or resolution."
"the cable and USB tunnel on your Mac"
"Could not start discovery (%1$d). You can enter an address manually."

"Negotiated: %1$s. HEVC is the default. Changing the codec saves your preference and reconnects an active session. Your Mac may choose another supported codec; older Macs use HEVC. Latency differences require A/B testing."
"Panel now: %1$d Hz. Mac configured: %2$s fps. Measured decoder rate: %3$s fps. Android may limit the refresh rate."
"Decoder: %1$.0f ms · %2$.0f fps\nMac configured: %3$d fps · %4$d Mbps · Panel: %5$.0f Hz"
"Uses the system language by default, with English for other languages. Changing language stops an active connection; reconnect manually afterward."
"Silent DualScreen status. Tap the notification to return to your Mac screen."
"The log is empty or storage is unavailable."
"Your Mac selected an unknown video codec"
"Your Mac sent an invalid video size"
"The decoder does not support %1$s at %2$d × %3$d. Choose another codec or resolution."
"The Mac video pipeline is unavailable. Check the Mac app and its screen recording permission."
"Your Mac rejected the connection. See the connection log for details."
